siteRecommendations: Add a source-ingestion mechanism to whole-site-update-v1, or an authorized resolver, that can ingest external public sources into real evidence rows and return their UUIDs. The current contract can publish a record but cannot create the source/evidence links required for a sourced article, so the September 6 Ghandour Hospital narrative investigation and regional news brief were vetoed rather than published with an empty source stack.

The homepage News lead was stale relative to the current edition while a newer sourced live publication already existed. This run re-promotes the sourced Ali al-Taher/Gaza update; add a stale-lead check that flags a News lead older than the homepage edition date without automatically replacing stronger material.

Expose an authorized external-source resolver for developing-story updates so editors can attach newly researched sources to an existing canonical publication without inventing evidence UUIDs. That capability was the blocker for updating the Ali al-Taher/Lebanon story with the September 6 Hezbollah drone and Israeli strike developments.
